steps.name: pre-pop3
cmd: ss -ltn | grep -E ":(110|995|143|993) " | awk "{print \$4}"; dpkg-query -W -f="\${db:Status-Abbrev} \${Package}\n" dovecot-pop3d dovecot-imapd; doveconf -h protocols

steps.name: zz-wait-bg
cmd: for i in $(seq 1 360); do pgrep -f "[s]tart.sh --job" >/dev/null || break; sleep 5; done; for j in apt baseline upgrade; do echo "$j rc=$(cat /root/cp-state/start/jobs/$j.rc 2>/dev/null)"; done

env.CP_SERVICES: ssh vsftpd apache2 nginx php mysql postgresql samba bind9 mail wordpress openvpn squid

steps.name: zz-pop3-check
cmd: echo "listeners:"; ss -ltn | grep -E ":(110|995|143|993) " | awk "{print \$4}"; dpkg-query -W -f="\${db:Status-Abbrev} \${Package}\n" dovecot-pop3d dovecot-imapd 2>&1; echo "protocols: $(doveconf -h protocols)"; ufw status | grep -iE "pop3|110|995|imap|143|993"; timeout 5 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/143; head -1 <&3"; timeout 3 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/110" && echo "110 OPEN" || echo "110 closed"; grep MAIL_POP3 /root/cp-state/readme.conf
